meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你找可安装的技能:先查 skills.sh 榜单,再用 npx skills find 搜索,核对安装量与来源后给出技能名、安装命令和链接,并可按需替你安装。
howto.when: 当你问「怎么做 X」「有没有能做 X 的技能」「你能做 X 吗」,或表示想扩展能力时,它会接管查找流程。

say.text: 有没有能帮我审 PR 的技能?帮我找一下
say.note: 先查榜单再搜索,给出安装命令

say.text: 帮我搜一下 react 性能优化相关的技能
把找到的那个技能装上
say.note: 用 npx skills add 全局安装

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude finds installable skills for you: it checks the skills.sh leaderboard, searches via npx skills find, verifies install count and source, then gives the skill name, install command, and link, and can install it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "can you do X", or express interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for reviewing PRs? Find one for me.
say_en.note: Checks leaderboard, then searches and gives install commands

say_en.text: Search for skills about React performance
say_en.note: Runs npx skills find react performance

say_en.text: Install the skill you found for me
say_en.note: Runs npx skills add with -g -y to install globally
